sourceBinding: Exact five production source SHA256 values. The root coordinator separately binds the committed browser candidate head; the old rig baseline is not claimed as the current implementation head.

corrections.native: Full weighted hand and forearm finite oriented cylinder diagnostics; native fixed-pivot local-delta quaternion approach transition. NativeBinding/NativeRig and original geometry/material/CSR/bone lengths unchanged.
corrections.bottle: Root production uses primary [0,1.0908,.44] and alternate [-.06,1.0908,.40], a 4cm smooth approach arc and actual 1/120s SPOOK parameters; the finite grip force and torque limits are unchanged.
corrections.window: 1.15s current native pose to the existing safe low prepose, then .65s quintic reverse of the verified withdrawal line to the actual moving handle. No live object pose or success-state override.

nativeAPI.beginReachTransition: beginReachTransition(target,{duration:1.15,side,frame}) returns true if already complete, false while active; solves a real reachable prepose and restores the visible source pose in the same call.
nativeAPI.updateReachTransition: updateReachTransition(dt) returns true when the fixed-pivot local quaternion transition is complete.
nativeAPI.hasReachTransition: hasReachTransition() returns boolean; rest(), beginRest() and setReach() cancel the pending transition.
nativeAPI.skinSynchronization: Each pose applies the original native hierarchy and updates that actor's independent CSR bone texture. No matrix linear interpolation, mesh scaling or child translation edits.

bottle.scope: Five real fixed stations × primary release, alternate release and mid-lift cancel; alternate tasks requested through production moveTarget().

windowCycles.scope: Each of three real native people opens then closes the same live hinged window without resetting its physical pose between operations.

windowCancel.scope: A first-leg cancellation with/without table support; five actual window stations canceling during the second approach leg; A holding the moving leaf cancels after −8°.

sharedInvariants.actualSurfaceScope: All original weighted display hand and forearm vertices selected by original native bone ancestry; exact finite boxes and local-Y cylinders with real world transforms, including cylinder end caps. These sampled vertices are not a continuous triangle or physical soft-tissue proof.

preintegrationCandidate.classification: Static candidate before Window controller integration; original shape dimensions match the live tests. Not counted among the 29 current live paths.

scopeAndLimits.fullHeadMaterialGPURequirement: Independent current-candidate Chromium gate; this numerical fixture retains original body/CSR data, not the full rendered head and shader.

bottleInitialApproach.status: Recorded existing initial wrist-frame clamps remain in the unchanged bottle approach. Their actual native surfaces, bones and feet are included in geometry checks; perfect Cartesian tracking during this initial phase is not claimed.

scopeAndLimits.assistedContact: Operated cylinder uses the unchanged 5mm surface gate; non-operated solids use 3mm. No claim of friction-complete fingers, fully physical limbs or whole-body collision.
scopeAndLimits.promotion: Producer numerical evidence only; public/browser acceptance and promotion remain with the independent verifier and root coordinator.
